name: Dynamic Saunas Santiago 2-Person Full Spectrum FAR Infrared Sauna
description: Dynamic Santiago Infrared Sauna DYN-6209-03 FS (Hemlock Wood) Do you want to live a long and healthy life? Honor your body and mind by giving yourself a healthier lifestyle. Take a break from the busy home and work life to reap the benefits of an infrared sauna! Dynamic Saunas use infrared waves to penetrate into your body tissue and can help dissolve harmful substances and toxins. The FAR infrared waves can penetrate the deepest into the tissue to help break down toxins as you perspire and wipe them away. Dynamic Saunas are constructed of Canadian Reforested Hemlock wood. This sauna also features Near Zero EMF PureTech™ heating panels , a floor heater, a radio with Bluetooth capability, privacy glass, and Chromotherapy Lighting. Add in environmentally friendly reforested wood and energy-efficient carbon heating panels and you can’t find a better product for a healthier lifestyle. Every Dynamic Sauna is equipped with a floor and lower bench heater that gets the benefits and treatment to your legs and feet too. Help not only yourself but others with your infrared sauna purchase. Features Carbon infrared heating panels are energy-efficient and can heat up your sauna faster than ceramic panels. Still have that podcast to finish up? Plug your phone into the MP3/Aux input and listen to it on the two speakers while you rid your body of toxins and relax inside the sauna. Find your best temperature and time by adjusting the LED control panel. As you get accustomed to the sauna, you can gradually increase either one. Specifications Full 2 person capacity 7 Total Heaters, 4 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF (EMF Under 2MG when sitting 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels) FAR IR Carbon Panels, 2 Near IR Elements. Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock wood construction Clear Tempered glass door and with side Windows Interior Chromotherapy Color Lighting System Interior LED control panels Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connection with built in speakers 118F-132F is the ideal temperature range, the sauna can heat up to 151F. Electrical service: 120 V/15 AMP Non GFCI plug & play (Recommend Dedicated Outlet) Extra Details Maximum Temp: 66°C (151°F) Exterior Dimensions (WDH): 47″ x 42″ x 75″ Sauna weight: 270 lbs All Golden Designs Saunas Include a 5-Year Limited Warranty. View more details here. What are you waiting for? Order your infrared sauna today and experience the Golden Designs difference. Videos
